h1: Custom Jersey Pullovers for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom jersey pullovers in bulk for your team. Soft, breathable fabric ideal for logos. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Jersey pullovers are a go-to for teams and companies that want a soft, breathable layer that moves with the wearer. Unlike heavier fleece options, jersey knit offers a lighter feel that works well for indoor events, casual Fridays, or outdoor activities in mild weather. The smooth surface accepts screen printing and embroidery cleanly, making your logo stand out. Whether you are outfitting a sales team or a safety crew, custom jersey pullovers deliver comfort without bulk.
heroAltText: Group of people wearing custom jersey pullovers with embroidered logos at a company event
